Method of Attack: Infecting computers with malware that mines Monero cryptocurrency
Using NSA exploits ETERNALBLUE and DOUBLEPULSAR to infect computers
Closing down SMB ports to prevent other malware infections and clogging mining resources
Impacted Systems: computers with SMB port exposed to the Internet
Attack Vector: SMB port scans and exploitation using ETERNALBLUE and DOUBLEPULSAR
Indicators of Compromise: Massive SMB scans predated WannaCry outbreak
Loss of access to shared Windows resources
Degradation of PC and server performance
Three Monero wallets used to collect mining proceeds
